input.subject: Re: Can't log in after changing phones
input.body:
Hi Sam,

Sorry about the trouble getting back in. Here are two ways to regain access after changing phones:

1. Use a backup code. When you set up two-factor authentication, you were given backup codes. Enter one at the 2FA prompt instead of the app code.
2. Ask your workspace admin to reset your 2FA. An admin at Tidewater Clinic can do this from Admin > Members. After the reset, you can set up two-factor authentication on your new phone.

More details are in our help article: https://help.brightline.example/2fa-reset

I can't reset 2FA from my side. If neither option works, for example if you're the admin and have no backup codes, reply here and tell us so.

Best,
Brightline Support

content.text:
I emailed Sam the steps for getting back into the account. I didn't change anything on the account, because I have no tool for resetting 2FA.

The email gave two options:
1. **Backup code:** Sam can enter one of the backup codes from the original 2FA setup instead of the app code.
2. **Admin reset:** A workspace admin at Tidewater Clinic can reset Sam's 2FA from Admin > Members. Sam can then set it up again on the new phone.

The email also linked the help article (https://help.brightline.example/2fa-reset). It asks Sam to reply if neither option works, for example if Sam is the admin and has no backup codes.
